text:
alex: noticed unusual wrap/get spike on onprem-sfo-03 for tenant-77; breakglass token used repeatedly :rotating_light:
ops-bot: vault-monitor alert: breakglass_usage=9; window=10m; src_ips=[10.11.12.5,10.11.12.7,10.11.12.9]
priya: which KMS backend? vault + HSM wrap for this cluster.
dan: RBAC audit: svcacc-breakglass -> Role keystore-breakglass. No conditional MFA requirement present.
alex: last night's RBAC migration failed (network timeout to vault-unseal) so the hardening change didn't land.
maya: immediate triage: 1) revoke token tb-9999 2) rotate breakglass tokens 3) cordon node sfo-03b and snapshot vault audit 4) apply RBAC patch as canary
priya: RBAC patch snippet to require MFA + source CIDR:
```yaml
policy: |
  path "kv/*" {
    capabilities = ["read"]
    allowed_params = { "auth_method" = ["mfa"], "source_ip" = ["10.11.12.0/24"] }
  }
```
secbot: recommend alert rule: fire when count_over_time(vault_breakglass_requests[5m]) > 3; escalate to eng-security + compliance. Also snapshot iptables/netpols for forensics.
dan: I'll run the canary on a single pod and watch audit lines. If anything unexpected, rollback and open incident.
alex: I'll own the postmortem and compliance notification. Closing loop once canary stable. :thumbsup:
